# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)
obj_is_vector = function(x){TRUE}

# Load data

participants <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv")
question.response <- read.csv("../data/conversation_QuestionResponse.csv")
questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Question.csv")
conversation <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Conversation.csv")
messages <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Message.csv")
persuadability <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityResponse.csv")
persuader <- read.csv("../data/conversation_AIPersuader.csv")
persuadability.questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityQuestion.csv")

```

## Merge & Filter data

```{r}

participants <- participants %>%
  filter(
    start_time > "2025-08-19 22:00:00",
    study == "4",
    status == "completed"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.factor(id),
    source = as.factor(source),
    study = as.factor(study),
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    native_english = as.factor(native_english),
    consulted = as.factor(consulted),
    questions_balanced = as.factor(questions_balanced),
    intro_condition = case_when(
      intro_condition == 1 ~ "Helpful",
      intro_condition == 0 ~ "Mixed",
      intro_condition == -1 ~ "Unhelpful"
    ),
    hint_condition = case_when(
      hint_condition == 1 ~ "Hint",
      hint_condition == 0 ~ "Conversation"
    ),
    feedback_condition = case_when(
      feedback_condition == 1 ~ "Feedback",
      feedback_condition == 0 ~ "No Feedback"
    )
  )

question.response <- question.response %>%
  distinct(participant_id, question_id, response_type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  merge(participants, how="right", by.x = "participant_id", by.y="id") %>%
  merge(questions, how = "left", by.x = "question_id", by.y= "id") %>%
  mutate(
    response_code = ifelse(response == answer1, "answer1", "answer2"),
    # response = factor(response, levels=c(answer1, answer2)),
    accuracy = ifelse(response_code == correct_answer, 1, 0),
    confidence_directional = ifelse(response == answer2, confidence, -1 * confidence)
  )

attn.checks <- question.response %>%
  filter(category == "attention_check")

question.response <- question.response %>%
  filter(category != "attention_check")

qr.pre <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "pre")

conversation <- conversation %>%
  rename(conversation_index = "trial_index",
         conversation_id = "id") %>%
  filter(end_time != "") %>%
  mutate(
    start_time = as.POSIXct(start_time),
    end_time = as.POSIXct(end_time),
    conversation_duration = end_time - start_time
  ) %>%
  select(-correct_answer, -start_time, -end_time) %>%
  # Merge persuader
  # merge(
  #   persuader %>%
  #     select(id, model_name),
  #   by.x = "persuader_id", by.y="id"
  # ) %>%
  merge(
    messages %>%
    mutate(
      message_chars = nchar(content),
      target_chars = ifelse(sender_role == "T", message_chars, 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(conversation_id) %>%
    summarize(
      n_messages = n(),
      total_chars = sum(message_chars),
      target_chars = sum(target_chars),
      cost = sum(cost)
      ), how = "left", by = "conversation_id", all.x = T
  )


qr.post <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "post") %>%
  merge(conversation, how="left", all.x=T, by=c("question_id", "participant_id")) %>%
    merge(
  qr.pre %>%
      mutate(
        response_pre = response,
        confidence_pre = confidence,
        confidence_directional_pre = confidence_directional,
        ) %>%
      select(question_id, participant_id, response_pre, confidence_pre, confidence_directional_pre)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    persuader_correct = persuader_answer == correct_answer,
    participant_correct_pre = target_answer == correct_answer,
    participant_persuader_disagree = target_answer != persuader_answer,
    persuader_success = persuader_answer == response_code,
    mind_changed = target_answer != response_code,
    persuader_changed_mind = case_when(
      mind_changed & persuader_success ~ "converted",
      mind_changed ~ "backfire",
      persuader_success ~ "sustained",
      T ~ "recalcitrant"
    ),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional, -1 * confidence_directional),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional_pre, -1 * confidence_directional_pre),
    # NB: divided by 2 (range -100..100)
    confidence_change_to_persuader_answer = (confidence_to_persuader_answer - confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre) / 2
  ) 
# %>%
  # filter(
  #   !(is.na(target_answer))
  # )


persuadability <- persuadability %>%
  merge(persuadability.questions %>% select(-id, -scoring), by.x="question_id", by.y="item_id")

```

## Summary of exclusions

```{r}

reasons <- c(
  "attn_check",
  "sources_consulted",
  "fast_rt",
  "low_message_chars",
  "total excluded",
  "retained"
)
excluded <- c(
  length(ppts.attn.fail),
  length(ppts.sources.consulted),
  length(ppts.fast.rt),
  length(ppts.low.chars),
  length(ppts.attn.fail) + length(ppts.sources.consulted) + length(ppts.fast.rt) + length(ppts.low.chars),
  nrow(participants)
)

exclusions <- data.frame(
  reasons,
  excluded
) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = excluded / nrow(participants) * 100
  )

exclusions

```

```{r}
qr.post.final %>%
```

# Hypothesis tests

```{r}

qr.post.intro <- qr.post %>% filter(trial_type == "intro")

qr.post.human <- qr.post %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_human")
qr.post.ai <- qr.post %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_ai")

qr.post.human.final <- qr.post.final %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_human")
qr.post.ai.final <- qr.post.final %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_ai")

# H5 frame: first-trial disagreements + Helpful-condition final trials
qr.post.fal <- qr.post %>% mutate(
  include_flag = case_when(
    (trial_type == "final") & (intro_condition == "Helpful") ~ T,
    (trial_index == 0) & (participant_persuader_disagree) == T ~ T,
    T ~ F
    ) 
) %>%
    filter(
      include_flag == T
    )

qr.post.human.fal <- qr.post.fal %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_human")
qr.post.ai.fal <- qr.post.fal %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_ai")

```

## Q1: Are humans or LLMs more persuasive overall?

```{r}

qr.post %>%
  mutate(
    persuader_correct = ifelse(persuader_correct == T, "Persuader Correct", "Persuader Incorrect")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = intro_condition, y = as.numeric(persuader_success), fill=persuader_correct)) + 
  facet_grid(.~interaction_type) +
  stat_summary(geom="bar", fun="mean", position="dodge") + 
    stat_summary(geom="errorbar", fun.data="mean_cl_boot", width=0.2,
               color="#444444", position = position_dodge(width=0.9)) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  labs(
    y = "Persuader Success",
    x = "Intro Condition",
    caption = "All trials"
  )

```

```{r}

qr.post %>%
  group_by(interaction_type) %>%
  summarize(
    persuader_success = mean(persuader_success),
    confidence_change = mean(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer),
    n = n()
  )

```

### H1a: LLM > human (PS)

```{r}

m.h1.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ 
             interaction_type + 
             (1 | participant_id) +
             (1 | question_id) +
             (1 | intro_condition) +
            (1 | persuader_correct),
           data = qr.post, 
           family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(m.h1.ps)
```

### H1a: LLM > human (CC)

```{r}

m.h1.cc <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ 
             interaction_type + 
             (1 | participant_id) +
             (1 | question_id) +
             (1 | intro_condition) +
            (1 | persuader_correct),
           data = qr.post)

summary(m.h1.cc)
```

```{r}

qr.post %>%
  filter(trial_index == 0, participant_persuader_disagree == T) %>%
  group_by(interaction_type) %>%
  summarize(persuader_success = mean(persuader_success), n = n())

```

#### Robustness: excluding reassigned participants

```{r}

reassigned <- targets %>% filter(is_timeout_match == "True") %>% pull(id)

# Simplified REs (convergence)
m.h1.ps.noreassign <- glmer(persuader_success ~ 
             interaction_type + 
             (1 | participant_id) +
             (1 | question_id),
           data = qr.post %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% reassigned)), 
           family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(m.h1.ps.noreassign)

```

## Q2: Is persuasiveness conditional on historically helpful interactions?

```{r}

qr.post %>%

  stat_summary(geom="bar", fun="mean", position="dodge") +

  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  labs(
    y = "Persuader success",
    x = "Intro Condition",
    caption = "Final trials"
  )

```


```{r}
             intro_condition * interaction_type + 
             (1 | question_id) +
            (1 | persuader_correct),

           family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(m.h3a.ps)

```

```{r}

m.h3a.cc <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ 
             intro_condition * interaction_type + 
             (1 | question_id) +
            (1 | persuader_correct),
           data = qr.post.final)

summary(m.h3a.cc)

```

#### Robustness: excluding reassigned participants

```{r}

# Simplified REs (convergence)
m.h3a.ps.noreassign <- glmer(persuader_success ~ 
             intro_condition * interaction_type + 
             (1 | question_id),
           data = qr.post.final %>% filter(!(participant_id %in% reassigned)),
```

### Truth-adjusted track record (deviation from prereg)

```{r}

qr.post.track <- qr.post %>%
  filter(participant_persuader_disagree == T,
         trial_index == 0 | trial_type == "final") %>%
  mutate(track_record = factor(case_when(
    trial_index == 0 ~ "none",
    intro_condition == "Helpful" ~ "helpful",
    T ~ "mixed"
  ), levels = c("none", "helpful", "mixed")))

m.track.ai <- glmer(persuader_success ~ track_record + persuader_correct + (1 | question_id),
           data = qr.post.track %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_ai"),
           family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(m.track.ai)

```

```{r}

m.track.human <- glmer(persuader_success ~ track_record + persuader_correct + (1 | question_id),
           data = qr.post.track %>% filter(interaction_type == "human_human"),
           family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(m.track.human)

```

### Mixed first trial vs. Helpful final trial (exploratory)

```{r}

qr.post.base <- qr.post.track %>%
  filter((track_record == "none" & intro_condition == "Mixed") | track_record == "helpful") %>%
  mutate(final = as.integer(track_record == "helpful"),
         llm = as.integer(interaction_type == "human_ai"))

qr.post.base %>%
  group_by(interaction_type, final) %>%
  summarize(persuader_success = mean(persuader_success),
```

## Message delay and length

```{r}

persuader.messages <- messages %>%
  filter(conversation_id %in% conversation$conversation_id) %>%
  mutate(ts = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC"),
         chars = nchar(content)) %>%
  arrange(conversation_id, ts) %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  mutate(gap = as.numeric(ts - lag(ts), units = "secs")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(sender_role != "T") %>%
  merge(conversation %>% select(conversation_id, persuader_is_human), by = "conversation_id")

persuader.messages %>%
  group_by(persuader_is_human) %>%
  summarize(
    median_delay = median(gap, na.rm = T),
    mean_delay = mean(gap, na.rm = T),
    median_chars = median(chars),
    mean_chars = mean(chars),
    median_delay_per_100_chars = median(gap / chars * 100, na.rm = T),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}
rating.cols <- c("model_persuasiveness", "model_likeability", "model_reliability",
                 "model_error_rate", "model_incorrect_training", "model_incorrect_instruction")

for (col in rating.cols) {
  m <- lm(reformulate("interaction_type", col), data = targets)
  cs <- coef(summary(m))
  cat(sprintf("%-28s type effect:  b=%+.3f t=%+.2f p=%.4f\n",
              col, cs[2, 1], cs[2, 3], cs[2, 4]))
}

for (col in rating.cols) {
  m <- lm(reformulate("interaction_type * intro_condition", col), data = targets)
  cs <- coef(summary(m))
  i <- grep(":", rownames(cs))
  cat(sprintf("%-28s type x helpfulness ixn:  b=%+.3f t=%+.2f p=%.4f\n",
              col, cs[i, 1], cs[i, 3], cs[i, 4]))
}

for (type in c("human_ai", "human_human")) {
  for (col in rating.cols) {
    m <- lm(reformulate("intro_condition", col),
            data = targets %>% filter(interaction_type == type))
    cs <- coef(summary(m))
    cat(sprintf("%-12s %-28s helpfulness contrast:  b=%+.3f t=%+.2f p=%.4f\n",
                type, col, cs[2, 1], cs[2, 3], cs[2, 4]))
  }
}
```

# Stats file

```{r}

stat_row <- function(model, hypothesis, measure, term = NULL) {
  cs <- coef(summary(model))
  if (is.null(term)) term <- rownames(cs)[nrow(cs)]
  z.model <- "z value" %in% colnames(cs)
  data.frame(
    experiment = "E4",
    hypothesis = hypothesis,
    measure = measure,
    term = term,
    b = cs[term, "Estimate"],
    se = cs[term, "Std. Error"],
    stat_type = ifelse(z.model, "z", "t"),
    stat = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "z value", "t value")],
    df = ifelse(z.model, NA, ifelse("df" %in% colnames(cs), cs[term, "df"], df.residual(model))),
    p = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "Pr(>|z|)", "Pr(>|t|)")],
    n = nobs(model)
  )
}
```

```{r}

decomp <- function(d) {
  s <- d %>%
    group_by(persuader_correct) %>%
    summarize(
      p = mean(persuader_success),
      mf = mean(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer[persuader_success]),
      mn = mean(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer[!persuader_success]),
      m = mean(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  T_ <- s %>% filter(persuader_correct)
  F_ <- s %>% filter(!persuader_correct)
  D <- T_$m - F_$m
  pbar <- (T_$p + F_$p) / 2
  mfbar <- (T_$mf + F_$mf) / 2
  mnbar <- (T_$mn + F_$mn) / 2
  flip_rate_comp <- (T_$p - F_$p) * (mfbar - mnbar)
  within_flip_comp <- pbar * (T_$mf - F_$mf)
  within_nonflip_comp <- (1 - pbar) * (T_$mn - F_$mn)
  data.frame(D_total = D, flip_rate = flip_rate_comp,
             within_flip = within_flip_comp, within_nonflip = within_nonflip_comp,
             pct_flip_rate = 100 * flip_rate_comp / D,
             pct_within_flip = 100 * within_flip_comp / D,
             pct_within_nonflip = 100 * within_nonflip_comp / D)
}

decomp(qr.post.final)

```

```{r}
  e4_min_id = min(p.e4.raw$id),
  e4_with_stp_rows = sum(unique(persuadability.all.raw$participant_id) %in% p.e4.raw$id),
  stp_rows_for_e4_ids = sum(persuadability.all.raw$participant_id %in% p.e4.raw$id),
  max_id_in_stp_table = max(persuadability.all.raw$participant_id),
  latest_stp_response = max(persuadability.all.raw$created),
  earliest_e4_start = min(p.e4.raw$start_time)
)

```

### Giving up: concession-phrase keyword proxy

```{r}

concession_rx <- paste0(
  "(you('|’)?re right|you are right|you may be right|you might be right|",
  "i agree with you|fair enough|i concede|you win|i give up|",
  "i('|’)?ve changed my mind|you('|’)?ve convinced me|i was wrong)")

persuader.concessions <- messages %>%
  filter(conversation_id %in% qr.post$conversation_id, sender_role != "T") %>%
  arrange(conversation_id, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  summarize(
    any_concede_kw = any(grepl(concession_rx, tolower(content))),
    last_concede_kw = grepl(concession_rx, tolower(content[n()]))
  )

qr.post.kw <- qr.post %>% merge(persuader.concessions, by = "conversation_id")

qr.post.kw %>%
  group_by(interaction_type, intro_condition) %>%
  summarize(
    last_msg = mean(last_concede_kw),
    any_msg = mean(any_concede_kw),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}

qr.post.kw %>%
  filter(trial_type == "final") %>%
  group_by(interaction_type, intro_condition) %>%
  summarize(
    last_msg = mean(last_concede_kw),
    any_msg = mean(any_concede_kw),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}

m.concede.kw.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ any_concede_kw + interaction_type + (1 | question_id),
                         family = "binomial",
                         control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                         data = qr.post.kw %>% filter(trial_type == "final"))
summary(m.concede.kw.ps)

```
